column1: # Query-expansion thesaurus: lay word(s) => document nouns appended to the SEARCH query only.
# The reranker still scores the ORIGINAL question, so expansion widens recall without inflating confidence.
# Format:  term, term*, multi word  =>  words to add
#   `scam*` is a prefix match; a space inside a term also matches a hyphen; plurals match automatically.
# Add a row whenever a vague question fails to find a document that uses different words.
cheat*, crook*, scam*, shady, bogus, fake, phony, swindl*, rip off, suspicious, fraudster*, dishonest  =>  fraud waste abuse FWA improper payments
patient*, medical, health*, doctor*, hospital*, clinic*, medicare, medicaid                              =>  PHI HIPAA healthcare patient privacy
leak*, expos*, reveal*, disclos*, private, privacy, confidential, sensitive                              =>  PII PHI redaction data privacy guardrail
insurance, claim, billing, reimburse*                                                                    =>  claims payer FWA
student*, college, university, campus, alumni, donor*                                                    =>  higher education advancement enrollment
visa, passport*, embassy, consul*                                                                        =>  consular affairs state department
bank*, deposit*, lender*, regulator*                                                                     =>  banking financial regulator
casino*, gaming, hotel*, loyalty                                                                         =>  hospitality gaming
pdf*, scan*, paperwork, form                                                                             =>  document extraction IDP
rule, compliance, policy, policies, permission*                                                          =>  governance guardrail policy
